h01-diego-studies-at-night.observed_description: Late at night in a small home study, Diego (dark curly hair with a little grey, short full beard, burgundy button shirt, as in 1.2 q04) sits alone at a plain wooden desk and writes notes with a pen in an open notebook, eyes on a thick open textbook (dark-green cover, pages of faint unreadable lines); a yellow highlighter lies by the notebook. The window behind him is dark blue-black and a desk lamp at the top right lights his face, hands and the books; a bookshelf of plain books, a mug and a small houseplant make it a home. No laptop, phone or tablet. Face in three-quarter view, sharp; he does not look at the camera. Whole inside the centered 4:5 crop (the notebook's left end and the textbook's right edge are trimmed); both hands natural.
h01-diego-studies-at-night.note: Usable: night (dark window, lamp light) and studying (textbook, notebook, pen, no laptop) read at every size down to 180 px; Diego matches his 1.2 look.

h02-ana-studies-at-night.observed_description: Late at night in a quiet public library, Ana (long dark wavy hair, light-olive skin, sage-green overshirt over a white top, as in 1.2 q02) sits alone at one end of a long wooden reading table with empty wooden chairs and writes notes with a pen in an open notebook beside a thick open textbook (blue cover, faint unreadable lines). Tall wooden shelves full of plain-spined books fill the background; the tall windows on the left show a dark night sky; a brass library lamp on the table lights her. No laptop or phone; nobody else. Face in three-quarter view, eyes on her notes. Whole inside the centered 4:5 crop (her left elbow and the lamp sit at the crop's left edge); hands natural.
h02-ana-studies-at-night.note: Usable: night and studying read at every size; the long table, empty chairs and tall shelves read as a library, not a home, so 'She always works at home.' can never describe this photo.

h03-sofia-works-at-home.observed_description: On a sunny morning in her bright home study, Sofia (long curly dark hair, warm brown skin, white blouse under a bright blue blazer, no badge, as in 1.2 q03) sits at a wooden desk and types on an open silver laptop whose screen faces away from the camera, eyes on the screen. Her stack of four plain dark-red books and a coffee mug stand on the desk; behind her are a wooden armchair with a patterned cushion, a soft white rug, a large monstera plant and sunny windows. No textbook or notebook; nobody else. Face in three-quarter view. Whole inside the centered 4:5 crop (the laptop's left end and the books' right edge are trimmed); the visible hand on the keyboard is natural, the other is half hidden by the laptop.
h03-sofia-works-at-home.note: Usable: daylight work on a laptop at home reads at every size and is clearly different from the two night study photos; Sofia matches her 1.2 look.

h04-luis-drives-a-bus.observed_description: On a sunny morning, Luis (short dark hair, clean-shaven, warm medium-brown skin, plain navy short-sleeved polo with no badge) sits in the driver's seat of an empty city bus, both hands on the large steering wheel, eyes on a tree-lined street through the big windshield. A yellow grab pole and empty blue passenger seats are on the left; the dashboard screen is blank. The camera stands beside and slightly behind the seat, so his face is seen in near profile rather than three-quarter view. A green street sign far right carries a few tiny letters and a dashboard sticker has a line of tiny print; neither is readable at runtime size and the street sign lies outside the centered 4:5 crop. Luis, both hands and the wheel are inside the crop; hands natural.
h04-luis-drives-a-bus.note: Usable with notes: 'at work, not at home' reads at every size; the face is in near profile (the prompt asked for three-quarter) and his hair looks straighter than in 1.2 q01, so he is less instantly recognizable as Luis; tiny unreadable print on a street sign and a sticker. No card depends on his face: every Luis card is solvable from 'never works at home' and the bus.
